channel.title: Dissolved Solids · The Journal
channel.description: Cocktail technique, Malaysian-local ingredients, fermentation, coffee, tea, and beverage culture. From Dissolved Solids and Soluble Solids cocktail bars in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.
channel.copyright: Copyright Dissolved Solids and Soluble Solids

item.title: The Tesseract philosophy
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: The four-dimensional analogue of a cube, translated into a cocktail. Long-form essay on how we built the Tesseract, our flagship house signature: gin, mezcal, maraschino, Cointreau, saline, citric, and a splash of tonic.

item.title: Best Malaysian cocktails to try in 2026
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: The 10 Malaysian-local cocktails worth tasting through in 2026. Pandan Collins, Gula Melaka Old Fashioned, Calamansi Highball, Kopi Sour, plus seven more.

item.title: Pandan in beverages
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Pandan as a cocktail ingredient. Flavour chemistry (2-acetyl-1-pyrroline), syrup technique, infusion technique, the Pandan Collins, and pairings.

item.title: Gula melaka and the palm sugar spectrum
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Gula melaka vs gula apong vs jaggery vs panela vs piloncillo. The full palm-sugar family explained. Plus how to make gula melaka syrup and the Gula Melaka Old Fashioned.

item.title: Malaysian kopi explained
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: The Hainanese-Malaysian dark-roast coffee tradition. The full kopitiam lexicon (kopi-O, kopi-C, kopi peng, kopi gao, kopi siu dai) and how it works in cocktails.

item.title: Calamansi as a bar ingredient
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: The Southeast Asian citrus that sits between lime and orange. Profile, sourcing, prep, and the Calamansi Highball.

item.title: Kaffir lime leaf in cocktails
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Daun limau purut, the aromatic Southeast Asian citrus leaf. The Scented Negroni (our house signature) and how to clap-not-muddle for cocktails.

item.title: Hibiscus and roselle in cocktails
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Hibiscus sabdariffa (roselle). The tart-floral deep-red flower that builds the Roselle Spritz. Profile, sourcing, syrup technique.

item.title: Cocktails for beginners
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: 15 cocktails to start with if you are new to the category. Approachable, well-known, easy to like, with notes on what they teach about cocktail-making.

item.title: A home bar in Malaysia
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Stocking a home bar from RM 500 to RM 5,000. What to buy in tiers, what each tier unlocks, where to source spirits in KL/PJ.

item.title: The four cocktail templates: Sour, Sazerac, Spritz, Highball
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Almost every cocktail is a variant of one of four templates. A printable cheat sheet of the four formulas, with worked examples.

item.title: Bitters explained
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Angostura, Peychaud's, orange bitters, and the modern bitters renaissance. How bitters work, how to use them, how to make tinctures at home.

item.title: Mezcal styles explained
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Espadín, tobalá, tepeztate, madrecuixe, pechuga. The mezcal varieties and how they show up differently in cocktails.

item.title: Clear ice at home
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: Why ice quality matters more than spirit quality for spirit-forward cocktails. How to make crystal-clear large-format ice at home with a cooler.

item.title: The sour template
item.dc:creator: Dissolved Solids
item.description: 3:1:1 spirit-citrus-sweet is the universal sour template. How to riff on it, what to adjust to your taste, how every classic sour fits the pattern.
